validation.matchPolicy: Exact EVSE identifier after punctuation-only normalization; no geographic, power or neighbouring-station inference.

notes: Only the 1601 EVSEs with an exact operator-direct tariff record and exact official-inventory EVSE join are eligible for the overlay.
All 3841 other official inventory EVSEs remain tariff-less and fail-closed.
Partner-network rows are not granted a DRIVECO tariff merely from network proximity or operator association.
